race.comment: KAHULA (5) and IDEAL FRANKIE (12) have both been dominant in winning in the first two rounds of the series but the draw favours the former. She led from one spot wider before saluting easily in last week's semi, taking her record at the circuit and distance to two from two. She can push forward again and looks hard to catch. A back row draw won't make life easy for IDEAL FRANKIE but it was hard not to be impressed with last week's 17m romp. She too has yet to taste defeat here and if things go her way she could still win. LA CANTATRICE (9) came from wider on this row when runner-up to KAHULA last week and she had recorded a string of wins prior. Draws for a trail so is worth including in the exotics along with SOHO ASTER (4) who would need to lift to turn the tables on IDEAL FRANKIE but has yet to miss the placings and draws for a first four result.
